subject.title: fix: resolve Tavily SecretRefs in agent tools

question: Should this broader PR be the canonical fix for the linked Tavily issue, including the agent Tool Search runtime-snapshot repair, instead of landing the narrower Tavily-only PR?
rationale: Both PRs repair the plugin fallback, but only this branch also addresses the agent runtime overlay that can reintroduce unresolved source SecretRefs; choosing the permanent landing and supersession path is an owner decision.

options.title: Land the broader fix
options.body: Refresh this branch, require green exact-head gates, merge it as the canonical fix, and close the narrower overlapping PR as superseded.

options.title: Split the runtime repair
options.body: Land only the Tavily-local change and track the Tool Search snapshot problem separately, accepting temporary divergence between agent tool surfaces.

options.title: Prefer the narrow PR
options.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95110 only if maintainers reject the shared agent-runtime selector and intentionally leave that broader failure path for separate work.

recommendation.title: Land the broader fix
recommendation.body: Refresh this branch, require green exact-head gates, merge it as the canonical fix, and close the narrower overlapping PR as superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned, updated the branch, and authored the consolidated reviewed commit, so they are best positioned to choose the canonical landing path.
